description: MATLAB scripts use BorgMOEA to allocate water-demand reductions among reuse, groundwater, aquaponics and desalination across 11 irrigation districts. The formulation has 154 decision variables and includes historic and RCP4.5-SSP2 disaggregation rules. This resource is provided by Piuri, Veronica. Coverage is regional as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists M formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The BorgMOEA dependency is separate. This is a study-specific Egyptian planning model. For simulation, it can support model-based scenario analysis. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
